text:
Liam: quick sync — finished the cross-quant comparisons on convo+instruct devsets (v2). pasted summary + proposed staged gating. need +1s before I schedule a canary.

Maya: paste the numbers pls

Liam: 
```
Variant | Token CPL delta (%) | Rouge-L delta | Safety (toxicity fail %) | p95 latency
FP16 (baseline) | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0.6 | 180ms
FP8             | -11.8 | -0.55 | 0.9 | 168ms
AWQ-4bit        | -17.5 | -1.22 | 1.2 | 148ms
GPTQ-8bit       | -14.1 | -0.88 | 0.8 | 158ms
INT8 (legacy)   | -21.7 | -2.30 | 1.9 | 152ms
```

Sara: FP8 looks like the best tradeoff overall. AWQ is attractive on cost but shows a significant Rouge drop and safety uptick. INT8 is a no-go for long-context routes.

Alex: what's the eval N and CI on Rouge-L?

Liam: 18,200 prompts stratified by domain. 95% CI on Rouge-L approx ±0.12. AWQ's -1.22 is statistically significant; FP8 is within noise but trending down on some code-assist samples. INT8 regresses heavily on >4k token prompts.

Maya: propose staged, route-aware gating (not single canary): start hosted 2% (split FP8/AWQ), dedicated 1% (FP8 only), private disabled for now. Autosamples to golden smoke set + live user sampling. Auto-fallback to FP16 per-request-path on gate breach.

Liam: gate thresholds I suggest:
- Rouge-L drop > 0.008 (0.8 percentage points) OR
- Safety failure increase > 0.005 (0.5pp) OR
- p95 latency regression > +10ms (if latency worsens)
If any hit, immediate per-route fallback to FP16.

Sara: for AWQ tighten to Rouge >0.006 and safety >0.003. AWQ also needs shorter burn-in (first 30m watch).

Alex: strongly prefer per-endpoint gating (chat vs code vs short-form). Also add golden subset smoke every 5 minutes.

Liam: agreed. example rollout config snippet to add to rollout-configs repo:
```
routes:
  - name: chat.completions
    variants: [FP8, AWQ-4bit, FP16]
    initial_hosted_traffic: 0.02
    initial_dedicated_traffic: 0.01
    initial_private_traffic: 0.0
    gates:
      rouge_delta_threshold: -0.008
      safety_delta_threshold: 0.005
      p95_latency_threshold_ms: 10
      auto_fallback_variant: FP16
      per_route_granularity: true
```

Maya: who owns the smoke alert hook? need automated sampling job + slack alerts + pager for sustained safety regressions.

Sara: evals-infra will own smoke jobs (quant-smoke-500). I'll push the streaming diffs to the rollout dashboard and create a minimal pager: fire if safety >1pp sustained for 30m.

eng-bot: rollout job created: staged-quant-gate-1919991234 — manual start required by @Liam :gear:

Liam: OK. schedule start tomorrow 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z. plan: start hosted FP8+AWQ split (2%) then watch first 2 hours. If AWQ trips gate, we drop AWQ keep FP8. If both trip, full rollback to FP16 + postmortem. Will post updates here.

Maya: +1 — also request we log per-client telemetry so product teams can opt out.

Alex: +1 on per-route gating. Add golden set of 500 high-risk prompts for continuous smoke checks — run every 5m and surface diffs as streaming table.

Sara: added job "quant-smoke-500" and hooked the streaming diffs to the dashboard. I'll also attach a short summary metric in the daily digest.

Liam: confirmed start. tagging @oncall for eyes :eyes:

eng-bot: user-action required: @Liam to confirm start window 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z

Liam: confirmed. will update thread w/ status during rollout.

Maya: thanks — please capture any unexpected long-tail failures and route IDs.

Sara: noted. will add a short checklist to the rollout ticket: smoke active, golden diffs streaming, pager configured, per-route metrics visible.

Liam: launching tomorrow.
